content:
Priya: Quick heads-up — candidate for SRE onsite got pushed to 5pm PT today. Need someone to be the scribe and confirm panel coverage. Current panel listed: Sam (infra), Elena (sre), Maya (systems). Can anyone swap/cover? also quick rubric q below.

Sam: I can do scribe if needed but I'm OOO at 2pm — can't move earlier. 5pm works for me. :+1:

Elena: I can swap to cover 5pm if Sam can take 2pm, but looks like candidate only has 5pm available? 

Priya: Correct — candidate only free at 5pm PT. So we need someone at 5pm. If Sam can still scribe at 5pm that's perfect.

Maya: I can take the 5pm slot and be scribe if Sam prefers not to. I have one small conflict at 3:30 but can push. :wave:

Priya: Awesome, Maya — can you also grab the runbook ask and check the candidate's takehome link? I will update calendar.

ops-bot: Calendar invite created and sent to panel. Event: "SRE Interview — Candidate X" 5:00pm PT — attendees: Priya, Sam, Elena, Maya. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/abcd1234

Elena: One rubric clarification while we're here — the interview kit shows two slightly different weightings. Do we score "Operational thinking" as a separate rubric item, or fold it under "System design"? I want to be consistent across panels.

Priya: Good catch. Hiring doc had 30/20/25/25 but PD and kit mention 25/25/25/25. Which should we follow?

Maya: My recommendation: keep Operational thinking separate (reliability/runbooks/run-time tradeoffs). Make weights 25 (Design) / 25 (Operational) / 25 (Execution/code) / 25 (Communications). That aligns better with the role.

Sam: Agreed. If we keep separate, add a quick scoring note for what "Operational" covers so interviewers are aligned: runbook completeness, failure modes, rollback plan, monitoring signals.

Elena: +1. I'll paste a short snippet we can add to the kit.

Elena: ```Operational scoring checklist:
- Runbook clarity (0-3)
- Identified failure modes & mitigations (0-3)
- Monitoring & SLO thinking (0-3)
- Rollback / recovery plan (0-3)
Total normalized to 25pts
```

Priya: Perfect. I'll update the interview kit and the candidate doc with that checklist and ping hiring@ with the change.

Maya: Also quick note for scribe: enable transcript consent and grab logs bucket link before the interview. 

Priya: Thanks — callout noted. @ops-bot can you also attach the candidate's takehome and runbook link to the calendar event?

ops-bot: Attachments added to the event: candidate_takehome.pdf, candidate_runbook_link.txt.

Sam: All set from my side. Thanks everyone. Good luck to the candidate! :tada:
